column1: # The scenarios the release check can run (.github/workflows/release-check.yml; docs/release-check.md). Tab-separated:
#   name          a rig example (suite.tsv or extra-suite.tsv row) or a diffrun rate scenario (diffrun/scenarios/<name>.json)
#   part          suite (a rig example on one jar), upgrade (a rig example with both jars on one network or data dir),
#                 rates (a diffrun scenario, base = baseline, candidate = candidate, rates pooled per role)
#   core          1 = always selected, whatever the changed paths; 0 = selected when path-map.tsv maps a changed path to it
#   baseline_arm  1 = the example also runs on the baseline jar alone in the same job (a red on both is not a regression);
#                 0 = it needs both jars by construction, so there is no baseline-only arm
#   rate          rates only: the condition pooled per role (diffrun/aa_pool.py syntax), then the pairs per shard
#   covers        one line, for the report
